text:
maya: Quick OKR pulse — infra/serving milestone check. Shipped: autoscaling hook + canary routing (merged). Slipped: quantization audit & docs. Owners, pls ack what you own and next steps. TL;DR: need CRs for autoscale changes and a rollout window. @alex @tom @chris

alex: Ack. Autoscale PR merged to canary yesterday. Monitoring dashboards added. Need one more CR for edge-case retry logic. @maya — can we schedule a 30m canary watch tomorrow? :thumbsup:

tom: I own quant audit. Sorry, slipped — blocker was missing perf runs on T4 farm. Running jobs now, ETA EOD Tue. Will post perf table and notes when done. :calendar:

chris: I own canary routing. Deployed to us-west canary at 08:12. No errors so far. small config tweak pushed. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4h with metric gates. Monitoring: latency, 5xx, token-cost.

maya: Re: CRs — @alex please ping eng-reviewers list. CR PR: #4821. Short diff: retry backoff + idempotency header. Code snippet: ```http
retry: exponential
max=3
```

alex: pinged eng-reviewers and added test checklist in PR. Left a note for integration tests target. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy canary started: roll_id=roll-2026-03-04-08; status=IN_PROGRESS

eve: FYI I'm blocked waiting on quant docs before finishing model onboarding steps. Can someone share interim notes or a short checklist? @tom

tom: Perf runs finished (uploaded). Small summary inline:
- dataset: perf-suite-v2
- quant: 6-bit vs fp16
- latency: +5% at seq>2k, p95 +8%
- cost: 2.3x token throughput gain
Logs: https://internal/storage/perf/1765552468 (internal link)
Notes: we should add regression caveat to docs.

alex: Re: PR tests — adding one more integration case for idempotency and a mock retry scenario. ETA EOD Mon.

chris: If quant audit slips further, fallback plan: continue routing to fp16 model variant and keep autoscale benefits. Not ideal but keeps SLOs.

maya: Next steps: 1) @tom finalize perf notes + docs patch (EOD Tue). 2) @alex finish tests + get final review (EOD Mon). 3) @chris continue rollout watches + abort strategy. 4) @eve pick up onboarding after docs patch. I'll add these as action items in the OKR tracker and ping on Monday.

tom: Update: perf job finished 21:03 UTC, upload complete. Added CSV of runs and a short README in the perf folder.

alex: Tests added and CI green on my branch, PR ready for final review.

deploy-bot: canary progress: roll_id=roll-2026-03-04-08; stage=50%; metrics=green; note=observability alerts OK

maya: Closing loop for this thread — if we have no major regressions by EOD Wed we mark the infra/serving milestone as "shipped" except for quant audit which remains "at-risk". I'll file the OKR note and follow up on Monday. Thanks all. :pray:
